query: How to justify and stratify calibration sample sizes across neighborhoods, disability types, age, caregiving status, time-of-day and seasonal heat, and set minimum cell counts per cohort?

response.query: How to justify and stratify calibration sample sizes across neighborhoods, disability types, age, caregiving status, time-of-day and seasonal heat, and set minimum cell counts per cohort?
response.answer: Stratify calibration sample sizes by neighborhood, disability type, age, caregiving status, time-of-day, and seasonal heat; set minimum cell counts per cohort to ensure statistical validity. Use established guidelines for minimum sample sizes to avoid underrepresentation.
